verdict.rationale: Cline's authorization docs list Bring Your Own Key as an auth path: you use your own provider credentials, cloud or local, as an alternative to signing in and buying Cline credits. The pricing page confirms you can bring your own API keys from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others without platform lock-in. Community users note running Gemini through Cline, which corroborates this indirectly. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that no Cline account login is required when using BYOK, and documented steps for configuring API-key auth in the CLI or headless mode.
